title: 第296章 杨伟大哥的酒第295章 天枢局的新时代
content_zh:
王建新从老首长家回来之后，连着几天都泡在天枢局里。积压的文件要批，积压的事要定，各个中队的汇报要听，忙得脚不沾地。每天早出晚归的，连囡囡都开始抱怨了，说爸爸说话不算数，说好了多陪她的。
他也想多陪，但没办法，活儿在那儿堆着，不干不行。
这天下午，他正坐在办公室里看一份关于西北边境的报告，电话响了。拿起来一听，是杨伟大哥。
“建新，晚上有事没？”
王建新想了想，晚上没什么安排，就说：“没有，大哥你说。”
“那行，晚上老地方，小食堂，我订了包间。就咱们几个老弟兄，好好喝一顿。”杨伟大哥的声音听起来挺高兴，“上次那顿饭吃得跟丧事似的，今天补回来。你可得来啊，别找借口。”
王建新笑了：“行，我一定到。”
挂了电话，他靠在椅背上，心里头涌上一股暖意。这几个老大哥，这么多年了，从来没变过。上次他走之前，大家聚在一起那顿饭，气氛确实沉重得很，每个人脸上都跟蒙了一层灰似的，连石军长那么爱说爱笑的人都没怎么吭声。
现在好了，他活着回来了，而且活得比谁都好。该聚聚了。
下午四点多，王建新提前从局里出来，让司机开车去了大院。
小食堂在院子深处，一栋不起眼的灰砖楼。门口的哨兵认识王建新的车，直接放行。他下了车，拎着两瓶自己泡的药酒，推门进了小食堂。
包间在最里头，门半掩着。王建新推门进去，里头已经坐了九个人了。杨伟大哥坐在主位上，旁边是石军、崔参、周参、赵部、钱局、姚主任、张局、李部。都是老熟人了，见了面也不用客套，点头打招呼就行。
石军第一个嚷起来：“建新来了！哎哟，还自带酒？你这是不信任小食堂的采购啊！”
王建新把酒放在桌上，笑着说：“这酒是我自己泡的，外面买不着。你尝尝就知道了。”
“你自己泡的？”石军长瞪大了眼睛，“你一个大局长，还有工夫泡酒？”
“业余爱好。”王建新笑了笑，没多解释。
杨伟大哥招呼他坐下，位置就在他右手边。服务员进来倒茶。”
杨伟大哥看了看表，对服务员说：“上菜吧。”
菜还是那些菜，红烧排骨、清蒸鲈鱼、葱烧海参、炒时蔬等等，再加一盆酸辣汤，简简单单的。但菜的分量足，味道也好，小食堂的大师傅干了十几年了，手艺没得说。
王建新把自己带的两瓶酒打开，给每人倒了一杯。酒一倒出来，满屋子都是香味。石军长鼻子灵，凑过去闻了闻，眼睛一亮：“好酒！这味儿真香，比茅台还香。”

“那你多喝点。”王建新笑着给他满上。
杨伟大哥端起酒杯，站起来，环顾了一圈在座的人。
“来，咱们先一起敬建新一杯。上次那顿饭，咱们喝得憋屈。今天不一样了，建新回来了，任务完成了，平平安安的。咱们这杯酒，是接风的酒，也是高兴的酒。”他一仰头，干了。
大家也都站起来，端着酒杯，齐刷刷地看着王建新。王建新站起来，心里头热乎乎的，端着酒杯的手稳得很，一口干了。
酒一下肚，石军长的话匣子就打开了。
“建新，你那个修炼的事儿，到底练到什么地步了？”他放下酒杯，用手抹了抹嘴，“上次你说什么‘以前是步枪，现在是导弹’，我琢磨了好几天也没琢磨明白。你给老哥透个底，到底有多厉害？”
王建新想了想，怎么才能让这些老大哥听懂呢？他们都是军人，打了一辈子仗，对枪炮弹药最熟悉。用这些东西来打比方，他们一听就懂。
“这么说吧。”王建新夹了一口菜，慢慢嚼着，等大家都看着他了，才开口，“以前我筑基期的时候，大概相当于一辆主战坦克。能打能扛，一般的步兵拿我没办法，但碰上反坦克导弹、武装直升机，那就悬了。”
“现在呢？”石军追问。
“现在嘛。”王建新笑了笑，“大概相当于一艘航空母舰。不是那种小型的，是尼米兹级那种。你想想，一艘航母开到战场上，一般的武器对它根本构不成威胁。它自己就能起飞几十架飞机，方圆几百公里都在它的打击范围内。一对一，没人打得过它。”
石军张了张嘴，半天没说出话来。崔参倒是听明白了，低声说了一句：“也就是说，地球上没什么能奈何你了？”
王建新点了点头，又摇了摇头：“地球上现有的常规武器，确实对我没什么威胁。但要说完全奈何不了，那也不尽然。大规模核打击、超级emp之类的东西，还是会对我造成麻烦。不过，我跑得快，打不过就跑，他们也追不上。”
周参插了一句：“那你现在能飞多快？”
王建新想了想，说：“具体多快我没测过，但比飞机快是肯定的。从京城到上海，也就喝杯茶的工夫。”
包间里安静了几秒钟。几个人你看看我、我看看你，脸上都是一副“这他妈还是人吗”的表情。石军最先回过神来，端起酒杯，咕咚又干了一杯：“算了算了，不想了，再想我脑子要炸了。喝酒喝酒！”
大家哈哈大笑，气氛一下子又轻松了起来。
酒过三巡，菜过五味，话题慢慢聊开了。杨伟大哥问起青海基地的事，王建新简单说了说，没讲太细，但把第一大队已经进入练气期的事说了。杨伟大哥听了，点了点头，说：“这事是国家的底牌，一定要捂紧了。”
赵部问起芯片项目的进展，王建新说就是缺一些技术人才。赵部说他们部里有些年轻人想下海，回头可以介绍过去。王建新说那敢情好，求之不得。
钱局话少，一直闷头吃菜，吃到一半才抬起头来，问了一句：“建新，你现在还能活多久？”
这话一出来，大家都安静了。
content_en:
After Wang Jianxin came back from the old chief's house, he spent several days in Tianshu Bureau. Backlogged documents had to be approved, backlogged matters had to be settled, reports from each squadron had to be listened to, and we were so busy that our feet never touched the ground. Going out early and coming back late every day, even my daughter started to complain, saying that her father didn't keep his word and had promised to spend more time with her.
He also wanted to spend more time with her, but he couldn't help it. The work was piled up there, and he couldn't do it.
This afternoon, he was sitting in his office reading a report on the northwest border when the phone rang. When I picked it up and listened, it was Brother Yang Wei.
"Jianxin, are you okay tonight?"
Wang Jianxin thought for a while, and he didn't have any plans for the evening, so he said, "No, brother, please tell me."
"Okay, I've booked a private room at our old place, the small canteen, in the evening. Just us old brothers, let's have a good meal." Brother Yang Wei's voice sounded very happy, "The meal last time was like a funeral. Let's make up for it today. You have to come, don't make excuses."
Wang Jianxin smiled: "Okay, I will definitely be there."
After hanging up the phone, he leaned back in his chair, feeling warm in his heart. These big brothers have never changed after so many years. Before he left last time, the atmosphere at the meal everyone gathered together was really heavy. Everyone's face seemed to be covered with a layer of dust. Even Commander Shi, who loved to talk and laugh, didn't say much.
Well now, he is back alive and living better than anyone else. It's time to get together.
At around four o'clock in the afternoon, Wang Jianxin came out of the station early and asked the driver to drive to the compound.
The canteen is an inconspicuous gray brick building deep in the courtyard. The sentry at the door recognized Wang Jianxin's car and let it pass directly. He got out of the car, carried two bottles of medicinal wine that he had brewed, and pushed the door into the canteen.
The private room is at the end, and the door is ajar. Wang Jianxin opened the door and went in. Nine people were already sitting inside. Brother Yang Wei was sitting on the main seat, next to him were Shi Jun, Cui Shen, Zhou Shen, Zhao Bu, Qian Bureau, Director Yao, Zhang Bureau, and Li Bu. We are all old acquaintances, so there is no need to be polite when we meet, just nod and say hello.
Shi Jun was the first to shout: "Jianxin is here! Oh, you brought your own wine? You don't trust the canteen's purchases!"
Wang Jianxin put the wine on the table and said with a smile: "I brewed this wine myself and you can't buy it outside. You will know after you try it."
"Did you make the wine yourself?" Commander Shi's eyes widened, "You are a big director, how can you still find time to make wine?"
"Hobby." Wang Jianxin smiled and didn't explain much.
Brother Yang Wei asked him to sit down, and the position was on his right side. The waiter came in and poured tea. "
Brother Yang Wei looked at his watch and said to the waiter: "Let's serve. "
The dishes are the same, braised pork ribs, steamed sea bass, sea cucumbers roasted with green onions, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, etc., plus a bowl of hot and sour soup, simple. But the portions of the dishes are sufficient and the taste is good. The master chef of the small canteen has been working for more than ten years, and his craftsmanship is unparalleled.
Wang Jianxin opened the two bottles of wine he brought and poured a glass for each person. As soon as the wine was poured out, the aroma filled the room. Shi Jun had a sharp nose, so he went over to take a whiff, and his eyes lit up: "Good wine! It smells really good, even better than Maotai. "
“Then drink more. "Wang Jianxin smiled and filled him up.
Brother Yang Wei picked up his wine glass, stood up, and looked around at the people present.
"Come, let's make a new drink together first. At the last meal, we drank so much that we were suffocated. Today is different, Jianxin is back, the task is completed, and everything is safe. Our glass of wine is the wine that catches the wind and is also the wine of happiness. "He raised his head and did it.
Everyone also stood up, holding wine glasses, and looked at Wang Jianxin. Wang Jianxin stood up, his heart was warm, his hand holding the wine glass was steady, and he drank it in one gulp.
After drinking, Commander Shi's chatterbox opened up.
"Jianxin, how far have you reached in your cultivation? " He put down the wine glass and wiped his mouth with his hand, "What did you say last time, 'It used to be rifles, now it's missiles', I thought about it for several days but still couldn’t figure it out. Tell me, brother, how powerful he is? "
Wang Jianxin thought for a while, how can we make these big brothers understand? They are all soldiers who have been fighting all their lives and are most familiar with guns and ammunition. Use these things as metaphors and they will understand them immediately.
"Let's put it this way. "Wang Jianxin took a bite of the vegetable and chewed it slowly. He waited until everyone looked at him before speaking, "When I was in the foundation building stage, it was about the size of a main battle tank. I can fight and carry it. I can't do anything with ordinary infantry, but when it comes to anti-tank missiles and armed helicopters, I'm in trouble. "
"What now? "Shi Jun asked.
"Now. Wang Jianxin smiled and said, "It's probably equivalent to an aircraft carrier." Not the small kind, the Nimitz-class kind. Think about it, if an aircraft carrier arrives on the battlefield, ordinary weapons will not pose a threat to it at all. It can take off dozens of planes on its own, and it can strike within a radius of hundreds of kilometers. One on one, no one can beat it. "
Shi Jun opened his mouth, but no words came out for a long time. Cui Shen understood it and whispered: "In other words, there is nothing on earth that can do anything to you? "
Wang Jianxin nodded, then shook his head: "The existing conventional weapons on earth do not pose a threat to me. But to say that nothing can be done about it is not entirely true. Large-scale nuclear strikes, super emp and the like will still cause trouble for me. However, I am a fast runner, and if I can't beat me, I will run away, and they won't be able to catch up. "
Zhou Shen interrupted: "Then how fast can you fly now? "
Wang Jianxin thought for a while and said: "I haven't measured the specific speed, but it is definitely faster than an airplane. From Beijing to Shanghai, it only takes a cup of tea. "
The private room was quiet for a few seconds. Several people looked at me and I looked at you, with expressions on their faces like "Are these people still fucking human?" Shi Jun was the first to come to his senses, picked up the wine glass, and drank another glass: "Forget it, forget it, I don't want to think about it anymore, my head will explode if I think about it again. Drink, drink! "
Everyone laughed, and the atmosphere suddenly became relaxed again.
After three rounds of wine and five flavors of food, the conversation slowly started to unfold. Brother Yang Wei asked about the Qinghai base. Wang Jianxin gave a brief explanation, without going into too much detail, but mentioned that the first brigade had entered the Qi training period. After hearing this, Brother Yang Wei nodded and said, "This matter is the country's trump card and must be kept tight. "
When Zhao asked about the progress of the chip project, Wang Jianxin said that there was a lack of technical talents. Zhao Bu said that there are some young people in his department who want to go to sea, and they can introduce them later. Wang Jianxin said that it is a good thing to be in love, but you can't get it.
Qian Ju talked little and kept eating his food. He raised his head halfway through the meal and asked, "Jianxin, how long can you live now?" "
As soon as these words came out, everyone fell silent.
